_meta.note: Walking-logic extracted from fandom route text + 2 annotated multi-panel images. Tibia 7.4 vanilla; verify on Rivalia. A SECRET underground passage from Thais to Kazordoon via the Mount Sternum caves — gives exp along the way. Image 1 = 9-panel underground maze (each panel: GREEN circle = where you enter/appear, RED circle = the hole/exit to the next panel, white arrow = path between them). Image 2 = 3-panel surface stretch from the cave exit NE to Kazordoon.
_meta.coord_system: Tibia game coords. z = floor (7=ground, higher=deeper). down = descend one floor (hole/ladder). green→red circles chain the cave floors.
_meta.legend: steps[] is an ordered walking sequence. The green→red circle convention drives the underground floor transitions; the two surface segments bookend the cave crawl.

from: Mount Sternum (cave entrance SE of Thais)
to: Kazordoon (surface entrance, via the cave exit)

start.note: Mount Sternum cave entrance near Thais; exact coords not given in source

min_level_note: Creatures en route: Cyclops, Bat, Skeleton, Ghoul, Bonelord, Dwarf, Dwarf Soldier, Dwarf Guard, Rotworm. May also face Crypt Shamblers, Mummies, Ghosts IF lured. Mid-level+; luring risk is real.

steps.text: PANEL 1 (surface): go into Mount Sternum SE of Thais (white double-arrow points down into the cave). Cyclopes are common right at the entrance.
PANEL 2: appear at the GREEN circle, follow the white line down/across the cavern to the RED circle hole, and descend. 'Follow the way from green to red circles.'
PANEL 3: from the GREEN circle work through the branching tunnels (white arrow) to the RED-circle hole and drop down. Maze section — easy to lure extra monsters here.

steps.heading: NE
steps.text: PANEL 4: GREEN circle → follow the white arrow NE across the chamber to the RED-circle hole and descend.
PANEL 5: short hop — GREEN to RED circle (white arrow up-left), then down.

steps.heading: E
steps.text: PANEL 6: the long gallery — from the GREEN circle follow the white line EAST across the full width to the RED-circle hole, then descend. Watch for luring aggro in the open span.
PANEL 7: GREEN circle → thread the tunnels toward the grey dwarf-structure area, to the RED-circle transition.
PANEL 8: GREEN circle → white arrow to the RED-circle hole (lower-right) and descend to the final cave floor.
PANEL 9: GREEN circle at the RED-circle spot, then the GREEN DASHED arrow points UP/out — climb out of the cave system to the surface. 'Then follow the map below.'

steps.heading: NE
steps.text: SURFACE PANEL 1: emerge on the surface; white arrows lead NE (across grass/water) toward the next segment.

steps.heading: N
steps.text: SURFACE PANEL 2: follow the white/orange arrow up the rocky pass; a short cave/hole segment (brown) bridges to the final approach.

steps.heading: NE
steps.text: SURFACE PANEL 3: green dashed arrow leads NE to the Kazordoon entrance area (red structure) — you arrive at Kazordoon.
